questions.question: What did Joseph say when he revealed himself to his brothers?
How did Joseph explain why he had been sent to Egypt?
options: God sent him to preserve life
God sent him to humble his brothers
God sent him to rule over Egypt
God sent him to end the famine
questions.answer: God sent him to preserve life

questions.question: Joseph urged his brothers to bring their father Jacob down to Egypt.
Joseph said, "It was not you who sent me here, but _____."
Pharaoh invited the family to settle in the best of the land, the region of _____.
